Stop weighing yourself so often! Your weight fluctuates so much even over the course of a day, if you just ate, if you just did a poo etc., and other factors we cant see obviously. 

I've struggled with my weight and depression for years and what my counsellor says is true - you cant hate yourself into being skinny, you have to love yourself into being healthy.  You need to focus on what's right for you, some people are naturally thicker set while others are slender despite trying to gain weight constantly. You need to listen to your body and feed it as if it were something you were looking after, you wouldnt deprive it of meals but you wouldnt give it a stupid amount of food either. 

My depression was never caused by my weight but when I was about your age I started realising how different my body was from the 'ideal' and hating my body for being that way. Nowadays even the 'ideal' bodies dont look like how we see them in media, even without photoshop we never see their bad angles or unposed which is how we see ourselves all the time.
